title: Uncertainty Calibration and Robustness Evaluation (Section 4.5 reference implementation)
description: Single-file C++17 reference implementation of Section 4.5 (uncertainty calibration and robustness) of a dissertation on hybrid Bayesian tactical spatial identification of Wi-Fi signal sources. Part A evaluates probabilistic calibration of a zonal decision probability: NLL, Brier score with the Murphy reliability-resolution-uncertainty decomposition, expected and maximum calibration error on adaptive (equal-count) bins, calibration slope/intercept via logistic regression, an ASCII reliability diagram, and temperature scaling fitted on a validation split (before/after comparison). Part B builds a degradation curve over a stress sweep with relative degradation, area under the degradation curve, the danger breakpoint (decision-tier transition) and the recovery time back into the calibration envelope (graceful degradation). No external dependencies; runs as-is on OnlineGDB. Synthetic illustration, not empirical results; operating points are to_be_validated.
